papers.abstract: Spatial intelligence, encompassing 3D perception and reasoning, is the essential next frontier of AI. Scaling current 3D vision-language models (VLMs) that rely on dense Transformers for spatial tasks incurs prohibitive computational costs. In this paper, we introduce 3D-MoE, a 3D VLM leveraging an efficient mixture-of-experts architecture with a modality- and spatial-context-aware probabilistic routing scheme, stably cultivated by a novel routing curriculum. To seamlessly extend 3D-MoE to embodied AI, we integrate a diffusion-based action head, Pose-DiT, transforming 3D-MoE into a 3D vision-language-action (VLA) model. By employing a rectified flow framework, Pose-DiT generates precise 6D pose actions in a single sampling step. Extensive experiments demonstrate that 3D-MoE achieves superior performance on diverse 3D vision-language benchmarks with drastically fewer activated parameters and yields higher success rates while enabling real-time inference for robot manipulation tasks.

analysis.key_results: 3D-MoE在多个3D视觉语言基准上以更少的激活参数获得更优性能，并在机器人操作任务中取得更高成功率且实现实时推理。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出3D-MoE，一种利用高效专家混合架构和模态与空间上下文感知的概率路由方案的3D视觉语言模型，并通过路由课程稳定训练；进而引入基于扩散的动作头Pose-DiT，将其扩展为3D视觉语言动作（VLA）模型，采用整流流框架实现单步采样生成精确6D位姿动作。
analysis.method: 采用专家混合（MoE）架构，结合模态与空间上下文感知的概率路由方案和路由课程；扩散动作头Pose-DiT使用整流流框架进行单步采样生成动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种基于专家混合架构的3D视觉语言模型3D-MoE，并通过扩散动作头扩展为3D视觉语言动作模型，实现高效3D推理与实时机器人操作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接扩展为3D视觉语言动作（VLA）模型，面向机器人操作任务，与本站VLA主题高度相关；其中的专家混合架构与高效路由属于高效推理技术，可用于后续VLA/WAM的轻量化部署。

papers.title: 3D-MoE: Towards Spatial Intelligence with Mixture-of-Experts for 3D Reasoning and Action Generation

papers.abstract: Splat-based radiance fields have rapidly diversified in primitive type, kernel support, and appearance parameterization. This diversity makes compression difficult: most codecs are single-rate, requiring a separately optimized model for each target bitrate, while progressive codecs remain tied to representation-specific assumptions that do not transfer across backbones. We introduce GoDe (Gaussians on Demand), a progressive compression framework whose central contribution is backbone agnosticism. It reorganizes any trained differentiable splat representation into a single scalable bitstream without modifying the backbone or re-deriving the compression structure for each new primitive type. GoDe builds a nested level-of-detail hierarchy via masked-gradient importance ranking, refines all levels with one quantization-aware fine-tuning stage, and stores the base layer and enhancement layers as progressive chunks compressed with shared entropy dictionaries. Any decoded prefix is directly renderable, so one training pipeline provides multiple rate-distortion operating points without per-rate retraining. Across five heterogeneous backbones and three standard benchmarks, GoDe achieves competitive rate-distortion performance while enabling faster rendering and substantially faster progressive decoding than existing methods. Project page: https://gaussians-on-demand.github.io/

analysis.key_results: 在五个异构主干和三个标准基准上，GoDe 在率失真性能上具有竞争力，同时渲染速度更快，渐进解码速度显著快于现有方法。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出主干无关的渐进压缩框架 GoDe，通过掩码梯度重要性排序构建嵌套层次细节，结合一次性量化感知微调和共享熵字典的渐进码流，实现无需按率重训的多码率压缩。
analysis.method: 掩码梯度重要性排序构建嵌套层次细节，量化感知微调优化所有层级，存储为渐进分块并使用共享熵字典压缩。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: GoDe 提出一种主干无关的渐进压缩框架，可将任意可微分裂表示组织为单一可扩展比特流，无需修改主干或按新基元重新推导压缩结构。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作针对分裂基辐射场的压缩，与 VLA（视觉-语言-动作）或 WAM（世界模型）无直接关系，但其量化感知渐进压缩框架对高效推理具有方法学参考价值。

papers.abstract: While ML model training and inference are both GPU-intensive, CPU-based data processing is often the bottleneck. Existing distributed data processing systems assume homogeneous resource requirements. They excel at CPU-based computation but either under-utilize heterogeneous resources or impose high overheads on failure and reconfiguration. We introduce Ray Data, a scalable system for heterogeneous workloads spanning batch inference and ML training. The key idea is to combine dynamic task creation for memory efficiency with dynamic task placement for operator elasticity. Making both decisions dynamically allows the system to adapt to heterogeneous pipelines where the memory and compute requirements per operator are unknown and variable over time. Ray Data addresses two challenges: (1) leveraging dynamic task creation for memory-efficient pipelining, and (2) designing a task placement policy that jointly allocates heterogeneous compute and memory resources to maximize throughput while limiting memory usage. Ray Data improves throughput on heterogeneous batch inference pipelines by 2.6-12$\times$ compared to traditional data processing systems. By leveraging heterogeneous clusters, Ray Data improves end-to-end training time for multimodal models such as Stable Diffusion by 31% compared to popular ML data loaders.

analysis.key_results: 异构批处理推理吞吐量提高2.6-12倍；Stable Diffusion等模型端到端训练时间缩短31%。
analysis.main_contribution: 设计Ray Data系统，结合动态任务创建和动态任务放置，提高异构工作负载的吞吐量并降低内存开销。
analysis.method: 动态任务创建（内存高效流水线）与动态任务放置（联合分配异构计算和内存资源）。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Ray Data系统，通过动态任务创建和放置优化异构批处理推理与ML训练的吞吐和内存效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 无直接关系；该系统用于通用数据处理和训练，虽可用于多模态模型训练，但未涉及机器人动作预测或世界模型。
